summary: Frontend-only validation of Reporte de Avance for Multi-RIF project prj_e586608e3579. Login via UI, opened modal, verified hierarchical grouping (RIF -> Stores -> Bank/Product rows), validated 3 RIF headers with format '🆔 RIF <numero> · <nombre comercio>', each grouping its own stores (Brasero -> Marquez+Centro, Barako -> Altamira, Carbon -> Altamira), no cross-RIF mixing. PDF downloads as application/pdf (33KB, %PDF header). RIF filter (Brasero) correctly narrows table to only that RIF with its 2 stores. All 7 requested checks PASS.
